L_p_note: Number of trailing prompt positions in window W. Verified against each subject's real tokenizer by wda.conditions.envelopes.assert_cue_length BEFORE the first model call. Fact F3 is the precedent: the predecessor discovered only at execution time that its registered surfaces tokenised to two tokens, which made its rule unimplementable as written.
window_parity: C_direct and C_frozen share L_p and max_new_tokens, so both receive exactly the same number of ablation exposures. Enforced by assert_window_parity.

C_direct.system: Answer with the final integer only.

C_frozen.system: Answer with the final integer only.
C_frozen.note: The rationale is pre-frozen and generator-supplied. It is never produced by the model under test.

C_gen.system: Reason step by step, then give the final integer.
C_gen.note: Ablates all generated positions, aligned with the paper's GSM8K setup. Its exposure count differs from the primary pair by design, which is exactly why G_gen is not the endpoint.

C_direct_prefill.system: Answer with the final integer only.
C_direct_prefill.note: Compliance probe for fact F4. Never enters the primary.
